description: Answers 'turn my StockCharts scan into a FinzData backtest.' Give a StockCharts scan (e.g. '[type = stock] and [daily close > daily sma(50,daily close)] and [rsi(14) < 70]'). Returns the FinzData signal formula (expr), universe, notes and a ready-to-run backtest spec; clauses not yet supported are listed, never guessed. No data is fetched - call run_backtest with the returned spec, or backtest_stockcharts_scan to run it directly.

start.description: Backtest start for the returned spec (default 2015-01-01).

name: translate_stockcharts_scan
title: Translate a StockCharts scan
